title: Value cites read a code span that wraps across a line break
why: Lane value-cites-rebuild, 13:49 CST Nov 7 (PR #1430): a Markdown code span `file.py: NAME = v` that wraps across a line break is not read. Note stale-cites-value-span-wraps in docs/debts/notes.md.
note: The stale_cites scanner joins spans at paragraph level, and respects strings and fences (rule building-scanner-respects-strings). Done check: a red test on a wrapped span. The check's verdict changes, so this is a build lane.
